library_preparation_preflight.summary: The existing test project already declares activemq-client, activemq-broker, jakarta/javax JMS API, assertj and logback. It runs an embedded BrokerService over tcp://localhost:61616, so no Docker image or extra Maven dependency is needed. The uncovered accesses are reflective calls inside activemq-client: URI property setters, transport and wire-format factory lookups, and serialization. Test code can reach those through the embedded broker.
risks: I only read the build.gradle and the start of ActiveMQClientTest.java. I did not run the coverage report or look at the uncovered entries one by one.

Some uncovered accesses may sit behind optional transports or dependencies (for example http, mqtt, ssl, or ObjectMessage serialization limited by the trusted-packages setting). If so, the agent may need extra test code. It may also need system properties such as org.apache.activemq.SERIALIZABLE_PACKAGES, or in-JVM transport URLs such as vm://, which avoid fixed-port conflicts.
The existing test uses the fixed port 61616. Extra brokers with the same port, or tests that run in parallel, could conflict. Prefer vm:// or ephemeral ports.
